questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you that you are in or approaching a school zone. Watch for children and obey the posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead so you can prepare for traffic or turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if you see one. Do not try to drive faster than an approaching train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. This sign tells you that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up, so you should prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black markings. They alert you to special situations or hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down and control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. Speed advisory plaques on these signs show the safe speed to drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must come to a complete stop, check for pedestrians and cross traffic, and wait until the intersection is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that when turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mark school zones and school crossings. Be alert when you see these signs and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see these signs, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street and risk a head-on collision. Carefully turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is illegal and unsafe to turn left at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a lane is ending. You must move left to merge with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. You must follow the law and avoid making a right turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the height clearance under a bridge or overpass. The number shown (such as 12 feet, 6 inches) is the lowest space available for vehicles to pass through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangular sign is always a yield sign. Slow down or stop if necessary to let other vehicles pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that you are leaving a one-way highway. Traffic will soon be moving in both directions on the same road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that road work is ahead. Slow down and be ready for unusual conditions or hazards in the work area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services available to drivers. These include rest areas, food, gas stations, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange and red triangle on the back of a vehicle means it is moving slowly. Examples include farm tractors, maintenance equipment, and animal-drawn wagons. Be prepared to pass safely or adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the upcoming intersection. Be ready to stop and yield to other drivers or pedestrians. Proceed only when it is safe.
